title: Meowaura's Modpack
description: A modpack that includes lots of performance and QoL mods
body:
A collection of performance / QoL mods that will boost your performance and experience by a lot, for anyone who wants to enjoy the game but couldn't bother to download mods manually  

Notes:  
You can get NVidium from https://github.com/drouarb/nvidium  
You can use [VulkanMod](https://modrinth.com/mod/vulkanmod) if you don't feel like using Sodium (could crash, didn't test)  
You can use [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons) if you don't feel like using Voxy  
You can use [Fadeless](https://modrinth.com/mod/fadeless) if you don't feel like using kennytvs-epic-force-close-loading-screen-mod-for-fabric
